notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: reviewed_by is null. The hardware path (native.py) was never run and nothing here ran on a spectrometer. This package is R1: the loader refuses the hardware backend of an unreviewed model-authored package only at R2 and R3, so that protection does not apply to this package. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's helper is PythonObjectDriver; this package is a direct Driver over the card's AST entry symbol acton_spec_interface:ActonSpectrometer, because the other entry symbol acton_spec:ActonSpectrometerHW is a ScopeFoundry settings component that creates the serial class in connect() (acton_spec.py:61-68) and adds no device command. NOT COVERED: the pixel-to-wavelength calibration get_wl_calibration/wl_p_calib (acton_spec.py:121-152) is a pure calculation on the HardwareComponent and is not exposed; write_turret (acton_spec_interface.py:95-97) and home_entrance_slit (acton_spec_interface.py:140-142) send no command upstream, so they are not exposed; the clone has no detector readout or spectrum acquisition. Limits: center_wl is Limit.operator_required because the clone states no instrument wavelength range (the -100..2000 nm at acton_spec.py:37 is a ScopeFoundry setting default) and site-limits.example.json supplies an example 300..900 nm overlay; the slit limits 5..3000 um, the grating allowed set 1..9 and the FRONT/SIDE exit mirror are sourced from the upstream assertions. Safety: the clone has no stop or abort command, so the e-stop is the native close() (acton_spec_interface.py:217-218): it closes the serial link, sends no further commands, and does not halt a move already executing in the instrument. The driver does not poll read_done_status after a move, so a state read immediately after a grating or wavelength command may still show the previous position while the instrument moves. No catalogue_requests: every binding is a catalogue class (cap.device.configure.v1); no extension id is used.
